clubs.description: GAAFFS has access to 11 miles of the River Witham in Lincolnshire along with streches of the R. Welland and R. Chater. Fishing for Grayling and Brown Trout.

beats.Beat_Description: Welland upstream of Collyweston Bridge in Geeston
R. Welland on 'Monty's Farm' - original beat
BH - downstream of Stamford to Uffington

beats.Detailed_Description: Bottom on N beat to top of B beat - from field boundary downstream of Washdike Lane to the bridge on Dallygate Lane in Great Ponton. Lovely stretch of wild river, small stream with some very deep pools, but also long glides and some riffles. Superb head of wild brown trout to 1 1/2 lb or so.

beats.Beat_Description: NT Belton House - centre section 'no fishing'
Syston Old Weir to Beet Pad

clubs.description: CTC has access to c. 5 miles of the River Cam in Cambridgeshire. Fishing for Brown Trout.

beats.Beat_Description: Classic chalkstream style glide with weed beds and dry-fly opportunities.
beats.Detailed_Description: A beat runs through the grounds of the EMBL / Hinxton Hall / Genome Campus. The upper limit for CTC is the railway bridge at the south end of the campus, and the downstream limit is the road bridge (Ickleton Road) which is just at the northern boundary of the campus. Parking on the road close to the bridge, before the level crossing.

Pools.Name: Bridge Pool
Pools.Description: Shallow cascade into reasonably deep pool going underneath the Ickleton Road bridge.

Pools.Name: Bend Pool
Pools.Description: Shallow riffle tail with productive nymphing seam.

Pools.Name: Footbridge Pool
Pools.Description: Deeper bend pool under overhanging trees.

beats.Beat_Description: Tree-lined bends with deeper pools and productive nymphing water.
beats.Detailed_Description: Middle section of the CTC waters on the Cam. From the road bridge on the Ickleton Road, down to the ford, and further to where the fishing stops (railway line).

Parking_Locations.Name: Duxford-Hinxton Ford
Parking_Locations.Description: Roadside near to ford on Hinxton Rd/Duxford Rd

beats.Beat_Description: Upper C beat connects to B beat at Hinxton Mill.
beats.Detailed_Description: Non-contiguous with the lower C beat portion, divided by a no fishing section through Duxford village.

Parking_Locations.Name: Hinxton Road Ford
Parking_Locations.Description: Park on roadside near to the ford.

beats.Beat_Description: Lower section of C beat from the railway line downstream to the A505. Some lovely pools and long glides, the central section is very wadable, with the upstream end being accessible after skipping a deep pool with a fallen willow. The downstream end is deep and slow as the river goes through a small wood - can be a tough wade.
beats.Detailed_Description: Bottom of the CTC section, some lovely fishing in the middle section - at the bottom it gets deep and a bit 'canalised' through the woods - some big fish in there, but hard to access...

Parking_Locations.Name: Station Road
Parking_Locations.Description: Roadside parking at bottom of C beat.

clubs.fullName: Leek and District Fly Fishing Association
clubs.description: LADFFA has access to c. 10 miles of the River Dove in Staffordshire. Fishing for Grayling and Brown Trout.

beats.Beat_Description: Fast pocket water with short glides and reliable summer evening rises.
Longer pools and broken runs with strong grayling potential in colder months.
Sample beat used for validating fishing beat configuration and display.
